say:2:1013131001:1.text: Didn't I tell you not to worry? What if something happens to you?!
say:2:1013131001:1.source_cn: 我、我不是说了让你们俩别操心的吗？要是有个万一，你们让...

say:3:1013131002:1.text: It's my fault... I'm always out all day, I can't properly take care of you guys.
say:3:1013131002:1.source_cn: 对不起，是我整天在外面跑，有太多照顾不到的地方……

say:4:1013131003:2.text: Oh, kiddo. Without you helping the Evergreen Conservatory, we'd have no food.
say:4:1013131003:2.source_cn: 好孩子，要不是你在外面帮冬青学会干活，咱们一家人的口粮...

say:5:1013131004:1.text: Our previous home was attacked by golems, so we moved here for safety...
say:5:1013131004:1.source_cn: 之前住的地方总被魔偶骚扰，也是为了我们能住得安全，才搬...

say:6:1013131005:1.text: Since we came here, you've never brought friends over. Who might these people be?
say:6:1013131005:1.source_cn: 自从来这里之后，你还从没带朋友回来过呢。好多年轻人啊……

say:7:1013131006:2.text: Grandma can't see well; are they your hunting pals?
say:7:1013131006:2.source_cn: 奶奶看不清，是跟你一起打猎的朋友吗？

choice_prompt:8:1013131006.text: Grandma can't see well; are they your hunting pals?
choice_prompt:8:1013131006.source_cn: 奶奶看不清，是跟你一起打猎的朋友吗？

say:9:1013131007:1.text: Not yet, at least! These people are powerful magisters and knights who have helped tons of people!
say:9:1013131007:1.source_cn: 还不是呢。他们是很强大的魔法师和骑士，帮助过很多人……
say:9:1013131007:1.male: Not yet, at least! These people are powerful magisters and knights who have helped tons of people!
say:9:1013131007:1.female: Not yet, at least! These people are powerful magisters and knights who have helped tons of people!

say:10:1013131008:1.text: And hopefully we'll be closer someday!
say:10:1013131008:1.source_cn: 如果哪天能成为朋友，就太好了！

say:11:1013131010:1.text: Ah, I nearly forgot. I'll get you guys some tea and snacks!
say:11:1013131010:1.source_cn: 啊，差点忘了正经事。请用些茶水和食物吧！

say:12:1013131011:1.text: Once we're rested, let's head to the Evergreen Conservatory camp.
say:12:1013131011:1.source_cn: 等休息好了，再往冬青学会营地进发吧。

narration:14:1013131012:0.text: At Marilee's place, everyone got a warm welcome and a good meal.
narration:14:1013131012:0.source_cn: 大家受到了梅瑞特家人的热情招待，在此饱餐了一顿。

say:16:1013131009:1.text: Even though you may not stay here for long... it would be wonderful if we were friends!
say:16:1013131009:1.source_cn: 没错，是刚刚认识的新朋友！虽然你们应该不会在这里久留…...
